ios.desc:
This is your invitation to be right where you are; to interact with the places and people around you in your day-to-day. We believe that WHERE YOU ARE MATTERS.

Kite is a new social content platform that opens up your world to discovery. Wherever you happen to be, you can place messages to a friend, or perhaps a meaningful thought or quote. Take a photo of some great latte art or your children playing in the yard. The content you place lives right where you place it, and others around you can interact with it.

So go out, explore, and discover your place!

show_hn.title: Show HN: Kite – Share and discover content where you are

quotes.text:
Hey HN!

Kite is a social content platform where the text, images, and videos that you post are placed where you are. Think Twitter meets Pokémon GO.

I'm currently building in the ability to share your content within groups, and I've got a whole slate of business features on the horizon.

I'd love to hear some feedback!

Cheers!
